annual_rain_source: IMD gridded rain gauges, mean of 2001-2025 (24 years; missing 2012)
di_link_status: Reported by WATSAN (both Arakot 1 and 2); not verified
water_before: Lean flow 1-2 before, 2-3 L/min now (guide); handpump was defunct before DI, now has water in dry season; water decent, slight iron
impact_beyond_water: A handpump that had stood defunct now gives water through the dry season, and the spring's dry-season flow has doubled. The water is decent to drink. Fixing the broken rooftop pipe at Arakot 1 will keep this going.
notes: Comparison spring without DI named on form: Paniyar Dhar.

annual_rain_source: IMD gridded rain gauges, mean of 2001-2025 (24 years; missing 2012)
water_before: Discharge reportedly increased in further springs downhill (Silogi village); water quality good
community_notes: Entire village depends on the solar pumping project; before: severe water crisis, 2-3 km walk downhill; now water available, vegetation and farming
impact_beyond_water: Families once walked 2-3 km downhill for water. Today all 28 households (about 200 people) have water in the village, and it now supports vegetation and farming. People also report more water in springs further downhill at Silogi. The Himmotthan solar pumping scheme works alongside DI here.

di_link_status: Not established: geologist could not find a connection (DTR claims one)
community_notes: Only source when JJM is not supplying; no impact from DI
impact_beyond_water: The naula is the only fallback for 2 households (about 10 people) when the JJM tap fails. People saw no change from DI, and the school handpump is now broken.
top_concerns: DI should be left out (it is not recharging the naula)
notes: Summary table gives 1-2 L/min; form 2-3 L/min (form used). Naula discharge method seen: mark level on a stick, remove 1 L, time the refill.

water_before: Handpump flow increased; handpump water had high iron
impact_beyond_water: The Gunogi handpump gives more water than before DI, and the spring's dry-season flow has risen. Iron in the handpump water is still people's main worry, so a water test is the next step.
notes: DTR places this spring at Chopdiyal Gaon; field and photo GPS place it at Gunogi.

water_before: Handpump has water in dry season; handpump water was very bad (red/brown) before DI
community_notes: Used by nearby houses; discharge had improved
impact_beyond_water: Before DI the handpump water was red-brown and people could not use it. Now it has water through the dry season, and the spring that about 20 nearby households use flows better. Reconnecting the DI line, cut during house construction, is the priority.
other_works: Check dams; oak (banj) and burans trees
notes: DTR places this spring at Gunogi; field and photo GPS place it at Chopriyal 2.
